Depth of field describes the region of the photo that will be in sharp focus. An animated graphic outlines the region in focus in addition to the hyperlocal region. Use of speed boosters, teleconverters, bellows, extension tubes and diopters are supported. Adjustments for photo print sizes or viewing distances are included as an advanced feature.

Reverse depth of field will determine optimal focus point and optimal aperture (f/stop) or lens focal length. Enter near and far in focus points and reverse depth of field finds the best lens focal length, aperture and focus distance. The animated graphic assists in visualizing the settings. 

Angle of view information displayed with an animated graphic enables optimal lens selection for perfectly framed photos. Alternative options include reverse angle of view calculations. Great for determining subject photo dimensions, distance or lens choices.

Notebook for photo session notes. Predefined categories include film roll or flash cards, photo details, camera settings, lighting, weather conditions and other details. 

Flash information to determine optimal settings when a camera flash is used including calculations for ISO, aperture, distance and flash power settings.

Information for exposure value, neutral density filters and reciprocity.

Equivalence calculator to compare sensor, film or imaging sizes to standard 35mm.

Remote camera triggering for supported cameras. Great for group photos, long exposure, high dynamic range or other advanced compositions. Visit http://setmycamera.com/smcpro/diy/ir/ for supported cameras.

Shutter speed recommendations to prevent blurred photos based on your camera and target scene. 

Field of view utility to assist in composing photos. Includes hot spot detection and motion stabilization. Can be used with iPhone/iPad’s built-in cameras. 

For post production is a utility for optimal print size. Based on factors of dots per inch/cm, viewing distance, film or file type and camera or scan resolution.

Includes an iPhone companion app for Apple Watch.

An in-app-tutorial explains the use of each feature. Easy thumbwheel settings for fast inputs without typing. Animated graphics for ease of learning in addition to visualizing result.

Extensive list of pre defined cameras or define your own. Supports Imperial and Metric units.

Some features may require in app purchases. For a comparison chart of included features visit http://setmycamera.com/products/compare/.
